patterns: APPSC asks direct article-number items: President's Rule = 356, National Emergency = 352, failure of constitutional machinery (AP HC 2020 case) = 356.
Grounds trap: 'internal disturbance' is no longer a ground (44th CAA); 1975 emergency = internal disturbance.
Time-limit items: approval within one month (352), Lok Sabha term extendable one year at a time; Arts 20/21 never suspended (Art 359).
Effects-of-emergency statement items (financial redistribution, executive directions) appear in APPSC Group-2.
AP angle: first President's Rule in AP 1973 (Jai Andhra).
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement and match items with more case-law (Bommai, Rameshwar Prasad) than the PYQs show.
